structure.unit: Fisheries and Habitat of the Tidal Waters
Compacts and Joint Laws With Other States

law.catch_line: Lawfully harvested finfish and shellfish; possession, storage, marketing and disposal
law.text: Notwithstanding any provision of law to the contrary, finfish, crabs, oysters, clams, and other shellfish caught in the waters within the jurisdiction of the Potomac River Fisheries Commission, in compliance with the regulations prescribed by the Commission pursuant to the Potomac River Compact of 1958, may be possessed, stored, marketed, and otherwise disposed of elsewhere in the Commonwealth.
